mapper.insert: INSERT INTO movie_comment (member_id, movie_code, content, score) VALUES (#{member_id}, #{movie_code}, #{content}, #{score})
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_num, c.member_id, c.content, c.score, m.nickname FROM movie_comment c LEFT JOIN final_member m ON c.member_id = m.id WHERE c.movie_code = #{movie_code} ORDER BY c.comment_num DESC
SELECT score FROM movie_comment WHERE movie_code = #{movie_code}
